name: Yonamine Jun
source:
An energetic kid living at the village's largest 'Yonamine Store'.
A girl who adores Hoshimi Island. Possesses boundless stamina and exceptional athleticism.
To help with the family business, it seems she spends summer vacations racing around the entire island on her bicycle.
Perhaps her unique way of showing affection – she has a habit of calling people by nicknames.
